test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A train travelling at a speed of 54 km/h catches another train travelling in the same direction and then leaves it 70 m behind in 14 seconds. The speed of the second train is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the first train = 54 km/h

Distance = 70 m

Time = 14 seconds

**Formula used:**

Relative speed = Distance / Time

Speed of the second train = Speed of the first train - Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 70 m / 14 s

⇒ Relative speed = 5 m/s

Convert Relative speed to km/h:

Relative speed = 5 m/s × 18/5

⇒ Relative speed = 18 km/h

Speed of the second train = 54 km/h - 18 km/h

⇒ Speed of the second train = 36 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
